name: African Bird Club Conservation Awards
summary: Small awards of up to GBP 3,000 for people resident in Africa and African institutions running bird and habitat conservation projects: surveys and monitoring, education, local bird clubs and awareness. A separate Expedition Award of up to GBP 5,000 exists for larger projects outside the applicant's home country.

geography.label: The African continent and related islands

reporting: Successful applicants must submit a final project report with a financial summary, which may be published; ABC can reclaim the award if it is not submitted.

calls.label: Three rounds a year (deadlines end October, end February, end June)
calls.recurring: Applications are received by the end of October, end of February and end of June each year.

geography.quote: The African Bird Club (ABC) funds conservation projects across the African continent and related islands through our Awards and Major Grants Programmes.

amount.quote: Conservation Awards of up to £3,000 each may be made to individuals who are normally resident in an African country or to institutions based there.
